animations.name: logo-wall-marquee
animations.description: Continuous horizontal scroll for the partner logo strip. JS-driven via CSS custom property --logo-wall-marquee-direction set to 'reverse'.

animations.name: product-pill-animation
animations.description: Hero headline animated pill showing cycling product labels (Jam, Ship, etc.). JS-driven animation with CSS variables for color-background, color-dot, and pill-label-inline-size.

animations.name: global-hover-transition
animations.description: Standard hover transition applied to interactive elements like nav links and buttons.

animations.name: bento-card-hover
animations.description: Subtle lift/shadow effect on bento cards when hovered. Creates visual depth on feature showcase cards.

insights: The design system relies heavily on a monochrome foundation (black with opacity variants) with a single blue (#097FE8) accent color for all CTAs, creating a clear visual hierarchy for conversion paths.
Button radius follows a consistent pill shape (rounded-full/9999px) for primary CTAs while navigation and utility buttons use subtle rounding (4px), reinforcing the document-first aesthetic.
The logo wall marquee uses CSS custom properties for direction control, allowing the same component to scroll in either direction without JavaScript animation logic changes.
